items_flat.title_en: Anthropic: Claude Designs Protein Binders Against Scorpion Neurotoxins
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic：Claude 設計針對蠍子神經毒素的蛋白質結合劑
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced that an internal Claude research model, operating largely autonomously over 64 hours from one initial prompt and four follow-ups developed with Citrini Research, generated 318,484 protein designs targeting five scorpion neurotoxins. Partners Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience lab-tested 211 designs; 17 met strict binding criteria (KD ≤1 µM at both labs, no off-target signal) against individual toxins from Mexico, North Africa, and the Middle East. Strongest binders reached single-digit nanomolar affinity and competed with a known neutralizing antibody epitope. Anthropic released all designs and data, stating it does not claim an antivenom.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布，內部 Claude 研究模型在與 Citrini Research 共同開發的一個初始提示與四個後續提示下，於 64 小時內大部分自主運作，生成了 318,484 個針對五種蠍子神經毒素的蛋白質設計。合作夥伴 Adaptyv Bio 與 Twist Bioscience 對 211 個設計進行實驗室測試；其中 17 個符合嚴格結合標準（兩個實驗室 KD ≤1 µM、無非目標訊號），針對墨西哥、北非與中東的單一毒素。最強結合劑達到個位數奈米級親和力，並與已知中和抗體表位競爭。Anthropic 公開所有設計與數據，並聲明並未聲稱製成抗毒血清。
items_flat.analysis_en: The result shows AI agents can rapidly generate and filter credible binder candidates for neglected diseases with low commercial incentives, compressing early design from months to days. Binding confirmation is only the first step; cellular neutralization, in-vivo efficacy, safety, and scalable manufacturing remain unproven, and multitoxin designs failed under the reported criteria.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示 AI 代理能為商業誘因低的 neglected diseases 快速產生並篩選可信的結合劑候選，將早期設計從數月壓縮至數日。結合確認僅是第一步；細胞中和、活體效力、安全性與可擴展製造仍未證實，且多毒素設計在報告標準下失敗。
items_flat.quote: Claude’s design campaign produced 17 protein binders that each bind to one of four scorpion neurotoxins that are known to be dangerous to humans. ... We have not confirmed whether these binders neutralize scorpion venom in a cellular environment, so we do not claim to have produced an antivenom.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude 的設計活動產生了 17 個蛋白質結合劑，每個都與四種已知對人類危險的蠍子神經毒素之一結合。... 我們尚未確認這些結合劑是否能在細胞環境中中和蠍子毒液，因此並未聲稱已製成抗毒血清。

brief_en: Anthropic published research showing an internal Claude model autonomously designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins, with 17 of 211 lab-tested designs meeting criteria. No major model launches in the window; other lab activity remains quiet.
brief_zh: Anthropic 發表研究，顯示內部 Claude 模型自主設計針對蠍子神經毒素的蛋白質結合劑，211 個實驗室測試設計中有 17 個符合標準。視窗內無重大模型發布；其他實驗室動態平靜。
